1. Scenario of Choice:

For project 3 the Spoke City scenario is my first choice, followed by Willowmere. 

2. Communication Preferences:

I prefere to work with a proactive group with good communication. So a high contact group would be my preference. 

3. Timelines

I'm ok with either here! If I had to choose one work up till the final deadline is fine. 

4. Scenario versus Group Preference

I would prefer to work on the Spoke City scenario over having the exact group my styles line up with.
